ideal: Fast, trusted tests: every real risk has a test that fails when it breaks, nothing flaky, and a red run always means a real break.

sources.title: Ham Vocke: The Practical Test Pyramid

quality: Every real risk proven by a planted break, 80% of its mutants caught, and no flaky test.
speed: The web suite finishes within a minute on a pull request.
consumption: Billed test minutes no more than the jobs' speed goals add up to.
